entities.name: Kang Jung-ho
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jung-ho Kang is a South Korean former professional baseball third baseman. He played in the KBO League for the Hyundai Unicorns and Nexen Heroes, as well as in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Pittsburgh Pirates.
